from struct import unpack

def unpackrgb(data, format_char, bit_lengths, swap=False):
    bit1, bit2, bit3 = bit_lengths
    total_bits = sum(bit_lengths)
    shift1 = bit3
    shift2 = bit3 + bit2
    
    r = (data >> shift1) & ((1 << bit1) - 1)
    g = (data >> shift2) & ((1 << bit2) - 1)
    b = data & ((1 << bit3) - 1)
    
    if swap:
        return (b, g, r)
    else:
        return (r, g, b)
